d:
Maida nahi, ATTA! Atte se spring roll sheet + achari filling — Masala Kitchen ki tried & tested recipe, ghar par hi banayein!
Poonam Devnani ke saath banayein atte ki transparent spring roll sheet — ubalte paani ka secret, bina maida, bina batter, bina steam. Filling mein achar ka twist, sheets freezer mein mahine bhar.
Atte ki spring roll sheet — 2 cup atta, garam paani, bina maida
Achari filling — sabziyan, paneer aur achar ka twist
Sheets freezer mein 1 mahina, rolls fridge mein 4-5 din
Fry, air fryer ya oven — teeno tarike
